## Unit 10 — Putting It Together (A2)

|---|---|---|---|
| L01 | *Last… · Two years ago… · When I was…* |  | set the scene |
| L01 | *There was/were… · It was…* |  | describe it |
| L01 | *first · then · after that · while* |  | move forward |
| L01 | *because · so* |  | explain |
| L01 | *didn't + base · Did… + base?* |  | negative / question |
